implementation.citation_owner: Persona metadata.case_file_outcomes; captures all cited item IDs from persisted terminal paper cycle decisions and retains case-file identity, criterion, frozen owner pool versions, checks and outcome evidence
implementation.outcome_rule: Compare the sum of net-of-costs daily paper returns at frozen before/after pool weights over the first ten distinct owner-reported trading dates after the decision; positive=helped, negative=hurt, zero=no_effect; missing or confounded paired facts=confounded

window_policy.authority: coordinator starting values frozen in the owner, not agent-selected thresholds

implementation.writeback: Existing POST /api/memory/writebacks/learn-feedback, source_event_type=case_file_usefulness, requires existing persona-svc JWT role and an exact verified tenant; no new route or credential issuance
implementation.ranking: 5 * (helped - hurt) / (2 + helped + hurt + no_effect), bounded in [-5,5]; confounded contributes no evidence of improvement; reuse_count remains a read audit counter with no ranking influence
implementation.review_queue: Three distinct hurt decision IDs persist memory_review.status=pending on the original canonical lesson; existing authorized GET /api/memory/retrieve?review_required=true exposes this queue in institutional/persona scopes
implementation.replay: Stable per-persona/packet/decision IDs, immutable outcome marks, Persona CAS outbox before network I/O, receipt binding validation, and per-entry PostgreSQL CAS for marks and read counters; multiple agent proposals citing one pool action cannot multiply harmful outcome counts
implementation.entrypoint: Enabled Persona lifespan instantiates OutcomeTrackingController on the existing cron reconciliation loop; it captures/evaluates persisted decisions even on a poll with no new terminal cron run

acceptance_evidence.acceptance: Cited IDs and helped/hurt/no_effect/confounded after the outcome window
acceptance_evidence.method: Authenticated real Persona pool version/decision routes remove a member under existing drawdown policy; real case composer reads real Memory retrieval routes; owner evaluates subsequent fixture paper books and sends marks through the real authenticated Memory writeback route

acceptance_evidence.acceptance: Bounded usefulness ranking and three-harm memory review

boundaries_and_limits: Paper only; no execution publication, model call, live/capital action or execution memory read.
This evaluates an applied pool decision associated with a citation, not causal credit for an individual lesson.

Only applied deterministic pool removal/reweight decisions have paired outcome evaluation today; staged and other decision kinds are recorded and become confounded with an explicit missing applied-decision reason rather than a fabricated improvement.
Missing owner books/calendar/incident state, changed harness, or confounders fail closed. If no full trading-date window arrives, the 30-day deadline records confounded.
Private marks stay on the cited persona's original entry. No private lesson is copied to institutional memory or a fabricated trade reflection.
Pending review is a durable queryable flag on the original lesson. This task does not grant an agent endorsement, rule-promotion, quarantine, or deletion authority.
Registry, provider/cron responses and paper outcomes in tests are fixtures. No hosted deployment, model-quality, trading-performance or live economic improvement claim is made.
Independent reviewer approval and supervisor integration remain required before done.
